# P29.3 — Targeted, relationship-weighted source breadth (ACTIVATE.3, Round 7)

## Summary
The **disciplined** form of "expand sources": adds/flips **8 high-signal, relationship-weighted
accountability/governance sources** — federal oversight, funding, fusion-center governance, and
under-covered municipal surveillance-oversight (CCOPS) jurisdictions — **not** maximal commodity camera
points. Each is a source-registry row behind a **rights packet**, flipped under **GL-GATE-07** per the
HG-03 answer, and promoted for its **existing** class connector (reuse, no bespoke connector code). Breadth
that DEEPENS the resolved graph: every source resolves onto an existing operator/agency/vendor/deployment/
program entity via the P28.6 accountability chain — never an unresolved pile.

Implements `docs/tickets/P29.3__targeted-source-breadth.md` (§22 source registry, §4 connector framework +
ingestion gate, §42 rights/licensing, §14.7 ER — new sources dedup in).

## Gate — HG-03 per source, answered "Flip under GL-GATE-07 + fetch" (operator, 2026-09-23)
Flipped under the standing GL-GATE-07 basis: **US federal** works record their 17 U.S.C. §105
public-domain basis → **CC0-1.0** (the per-source packet winning); **US municipal** public records →
**LicenseRef-PublicRecord-FactualCompilation** (facts of a factual compilation not copyrightable, Feist);
**non-US** → **LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight**. Each flip carries its rights packet + reviewer role +
date + a P27.2 dispositions row — never a raw registry bypass. **Operational refinement:** the OSM ingest
is in flight on the shared `db-f1-micro`, so the heavy hosted fetch + dedup-into-resolved is DEFERRED
(D-R7.3-BREADTH); the flips + deterministic proof are done now, no fabricated live green.

## Design decisions
- **Reuse over duplicate / reimplement (SIG-ENG-035):** flipped pre-registered gated CCOPS discovery rows
  in place; mapped every source to an existing connector class; CONSUMED the loader gate, `db.rights_decisions`,
  and the licence compartments. **No new ADR** (no new normative decision; no frozen-layout change).
- **Deepen, not enlarge:** each source is relationship-weighted (accountability layer resolving onto
  existing entities). A source that could not dedup into the resolved graph would be out of scope.
- **Honest deferral under contention:** the heavy hosted half (live fetch, dedup-into-resolved, the hosted
  `rights-decisions --apply`, connector wiring, cadence rows) is DEFERRED (D-R7.3-BREADTH) — the OSM land is
  in flight and the hosted resolved graph is empty until D-R6.1. Deterministic + local is the proof bar.
